The complete close-cropped hair and head, both hands, wooden comb, asymmetric hem, both trouser legs, both boots, and grounding shadow remain fully visible inside generous parchment margins.

Visible brush planes, controlled illustrative skin and textile modeling, matte repaired cloth, softened edges, and a warm parchment wash establish a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing rather than photography, plastic 3D, or cel anime.

Joris’s plus-size heavy natural mass, medium-deep skin, long narrow face, deep-set eyes, heavy level brow, upturned nose, heavy lower lip, subtle age lines, red-copper close crop with sculpted edge pattern, restrained teal-brown repaired asymmetric patchwork, uneven hem, toggles, practical trousers, knee folds, leading shoulder, direct gaze, and wooden comb are legible. However, the declared compact finger-line tattoo family expands into extensive geometric markings across the neck, chest, both forearms, and hands, violating its bounded scope.
The direct deep-set gaze, level heavy brow, and closed heavy lower lip read as calm and neutral without a smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

The repaired cloth, practical trousers, low-profile toggles, soft boots, and bone-free wooden comb remain ordinary mortal details. There is no weapon, elite armor, crown, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, or text.

Joris’s heavy construction, long narrow marked face, close sculpted copper crop, teal-brown patchwork workwear, leading-shoulder stance, and wooden comb are visibly distinct from the reference person and do not transfer the reference braid, ochre robes, slim body, pose, progression ornament, or identity.
